sentences.text: Mahendra Kumar Srivastava vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023

Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 87
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 6197 of 2023
Applicant :- Mahendra Kumar Srivastava
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Anupam Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant bail application has been filed with a prayer to release the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 1022 of 2022, registered under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 34 I.P.C. and Section 66-D of I.T. Act, Police Station Sadar Bazar, District Shahjahanpur during pendency of the trial.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.
Five persons have been arrested in the alleged offence.

Out of five, four accused persons, namely, Mohammad Ajam, Raj Kumar Singh, Gopal Gupta, Jitesh Kumar Srivastava have been granted bail by co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide orders dated 20.12.2022, 16.01.2023, 27.01.2023 and 18.01.2023.
Applicant's case is similar to the co-accused, hence, applicant is also entitled for bail on the ground of same footing.
There is no specific role assigned to the applicant.
There is no evidence against the applicant.

The applicant is Mahendra Kumar Srivastava vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132082817/
1 languishing in jail since 02.11.2022.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and the law laid down by the Apex Court in Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant, Mahendra Kumar Srivastava, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
2. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
3. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 23.3.2023 Nitin Verma  Mahendra Kumar Srivastava vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132082817/
